description: Turns onyo-mode on in every session. When a session starts, resumes, clears, or compacts, prints its text in three parts, each under the 10,000 characters Claude Code keeps whole from one hook command. A solo session or a Claude Projects thread gets all of onyo-mode with a short note. A Projects coordinator gets a note, the Orchestrate playbook, and onyo-mode's playbook list. A line of just `onyo-mode off` in CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md turns it off for the project.
